title: Continue a gate after its source lane changes
when: A source-backed CI gate rebases or merges the lane containing its own imported code.
need: Let the gate continue in its fresh interpreter on the prepared candidate. If qa_ci_source_restart_failed appears, preserve the updated lane and rerun the same case; it checks for an existing CI run before another update.
surface: QA CLI guidance and gate progress
review: Source and subprocess regression coverage; deployed behavior is not yet proven.
